entry.en: Colombian immigration authorities recommend a passport that expires at least 6 months after the planned departure date.
entry.es: Las autoridades migratorias colombianas recomiendan un pasaporte que venza al menos 6 meses después de la fecha prevista de salida.
entry.quote: However, Colombian immigration authorities recommend your passport has an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you plan to leave.

entry.en: Travelers must be able to show an onward or return ticket valid within the 90-day period.
entry.es: Los viajeros deben poder mostrar un billete de continuación o de regreso válido dentro del período de 90 días.
entry.quote: You must be able to show an onward or return ticket valid within the 90-day period.

entry.en: Colombian authorities advise completing the Check-Mig form on Migración Colombia to speed up entry, although it is not mandatory.
entry.es: Las autoridades colombianas aconsejan completar el formulario Check-Mig de Migración Colombia para agilizar la entrada, aunque no es obligatorio.
entry.quote: Colombian authorities advise that you can speed up your entry to the country by completing the ‘Check-Mig’ form on Migración Colombia, although this is not mandatory.

entry.en: Up to 10,000 US dollars-worth of any currency can be brought into Colombia, and anything above must be declared to the DIAN.
entry.es: Se pueden llevar a Colombia hasta 10.000 dólares estadounidenses en cualquier moneda, y todo lo que exceda debe declararse ante la DIAN.
entry.quote: You can bring up to 10,000 US dollars-worth of any currency into Colombia. You must declare anything above this amount with the National Tax and Customs Directorate (DIAN) (in Spanish).

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you arrive from certain countries with a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si se llega desde ciertos países con riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: To enter Colombia, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you are arriving from certain countries with a transmission risk.

entry.en: For the islands of San Andres, Providencia and Santa Catalina, a tourist card must be bought at the boarding gate on the day of the flight.
entry.es: Para las islas de San Andrés, Providencia y Santa Catalina hay que comprar una tarjeta de turista en la puerta de embarque el día del vuelo.
entry.quote: If you’re travelling to the islands of San Andres, Providencia or Santa Catalina, you must buy a tourist card from the boarding gate, on the day of the flight.

safety.en: Short-term opportunistic abductions known as express kidnappings are common in Colombia.
safety.es: Los secuestros express, abducciones oportunistas de corta duración, son comunes en Colombia.
safety.quote: Short-term opportunistic abductions known as ‘express kidnappings’ are common in Colombia.

safety.en: Many armed groups remain active throughout the country despite the 2016 peace agreement with the FARC.
safety.es: Muchos grupos armados siguen activos en todo el país a pesar del acuerdo de paz de 2016 con las FARC.
safety.quote: Despite the landmark peace agreement between the government and the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) in 2016, many armed groups remain active throughout the country.

safety.en: Pickpocketing, mugging and armed robbery are a problem, especially in major cities and on the Caribbean coast.
safety.es: Los carteristas, atracos y robos a mano armada son un problema, sobre todo en las grandes ciudades y en la costa caribeña.
safety.quote: Pickpocketing, mugging and armed robbery are a problem, especially in major cities, including Bogotá, Medellín, Cali and the Caribbean coast.

safety.en: Criminals in Colombia have been reported to use drugs such as scopolamine to subdue their victims.
safety.es: Se ha informado de delincuentes en Colombia que usan drogas como la escopolamina para someter a sus víctimas.
safety.quote: The British Embassy has received reports of criminals in Colombia using drugs to subdue their victims. This includes the use of scopolamine, which temporarily incapacitates victims.

safety.en: Use licensed phone or internet-based taxi services or book through your hotel, and do not hail taxis on the street.
safety.es: Use taxis con licencia pedidos por teléfono o internet, o reserve por su hotel, y no pare taxis en la calle.
safety.quote: Use licensed telephone or internet-based taxi services whenever possible or book through your hotel. Many restaurants in Colombia will book a taxi for you. Do not hail taxis on the street.

safety.en: There is a risk from landmines throughout Colombia, especially in rural and remote areas.
safety.es: Hay riesgo de minas terrestres en todo Colombia, especialmente en zonas rurales y remotas.
safety.quote: There is a risk from landmines throughout Colombia, especially in rural and remote areas.

health.en: Tap water is safe to drink only in Bogotá, so drink only bottled water and avoid ice in drinks.
health.es: El agua del grifo solo es segura para beber en Bogotá, así que beba solo agua embotellada y evite el hielo en las bebidas.
health.quote: Tap water is safe to drink only in Bogotá. You should drink only bottled water and avoid ice in drinks.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Colombia, including Bogotá and areas of Cundinamarca, Boyacá, Nariño and Antioquia.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en partes de Colombia, incluida Bogotá y zonas de Cundinamarca, Boyacá, Nariño y Antioquia.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Colombia, including Bogotá and areas in the Departments of Cundinamarca, Boyacá, Nariño and Antioquia.

health.en: Private clinics in large cities and state capitals provide good quality care for routine and complex treatment.
health.es: Las clínicas privadas de las grandes ciudades y capitales de departamento ofrecen atención de buena calidad para tratamientos rutinarios y complejos.
health.quote: In large cities and state capitals, private clinics provide good quality care for routine and complex treatment.

health.en: Public health facilities and those in smaller cities are generally ill equipped and poorly funded.
health.es: Los centros de salud públicos y los de ciudades más pequeñas suelen estar mal equipados y con poca financiación.
health.quote: Public health facilities and those in smaller cities are generally ill equipped and poorly funded. Ambulance services in remote areas are unreliable and public hospitals often lack adequate medical supplies.

health.en: Mosquitoes carry malaria, yellow fever and dengue in lowland parts of the country, more so outside major cities.
health.es: Los mosquitos transmiten malaria, fiebre amarilla y dengue en las tierras bajas del país, más aún fuera de las grandes ciudades.
health.quote: Tropical diseases are a concern in lowland parts of the country, and more so outside of major cities. Mosquitoes carry malaria, Yellow fever, and Dengue, and infection rates are similar to other lowland parts of South America

health.en: Prescriptions must be written in Spanish, in the metric system and using the medicine's generic name.
health.es: Las recetas deben estar escritas en español, en sistema métrico y con el nombre genérico del medicamento.
health.quote: Prescriptions must be written in Spanish, in the metric system and using the medicine’s generic name.

help.en: Emergency numbers in Colombia are 123 for ambulance and police and 119 for fire.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en Colombia son el 123 para ambulancia y policía y el 119 para bomberos.

help.en: The 141 national toll-free line and the Child and Adolescent Police offer 24-hour protection and emergency help for children and young people.
help.es: La línea nacional gratuita 141 y la Policía de Infancia y Adolescencia ofrecen protección y atención de emergencias las 24 horas para niños y jóvenes.
help.quote: The 141 national toll-free line and the Child and Adolescent Police are available for 24-hour protection, emergencies and orientation of children and young people.

getting_in.en: There are regular international flights into major cities including Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Bucaramanga, Cartagena, Pereira and San Andrés.
getting_in.es: Hay vuelos internacionales regulares a las principales ciudades, entre ellas Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Bucaramanga, Cartagena, Pereira y San Andrés.
getting_in.quote: There are regular international flights into major cities including Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Bucaramanga, Cartagena, Pereira and San Andrés Islands

getting_in.en: Medellín has two airports: international and long-range domestic flights use José María Córdova (MDE), regional ones use Olaya Herrera (EOH).
getting_in.es: Medellín tiene dos aeropuertos: los vuelos internacionales y nacionales de largo alcance usan José María Córdova (MDE) y los regionales Olaya Herrera (EOH).
getting_in.quote: Medellín is the only Colombian city served by 2 airports: International and long-range domestic flights go to José María Córdova International Airport (MDE IATA) while regional and some other domestic flights arrive in Olaya Herrera airport (EOH IATA).

getting_in.en: Colombian airlines require proof of onward travel at the gate before boarding any flight into the country.
getting_in.es: Las aerolíneas colombianas exigen prueba de viaje de continuación en la puerta de embarque antes de abordar cualquier vuelo hacia el país.
getting_in.quote: Note that Colombian airlines will require proof of onward travel at the gate prior to boarding any flight into the country.

getting_in.en: Taxis from the airports are regulated, reasonably priced and safe.
getting_in.es: Los taxis desde los aeropuertos están regulados, tienen precios razonables y son seguros.
getting_in.quote: Taxis are regulated, reasonably priced and safe from the airports.

getting_in.en: From Ecuador you can enter by the Tulcán-Ipiales (Rumichaca) pass.
getting_in.es: Desde Ecuador se puede entrar por el paso Tulcán-Ipiales (Rumichaca).
getting_in.quote: Enter from Ecuador by the Tulcán-Ipiales (Rumichaca) pass.

getting_in.en: You can't cross from Panama to Colombia by bus because the Darien Gap begins at Yaviza, where the Interamericana runs out.
getting_in.es: No se puede cruzar de Panamá a Colombia en autobús porque el Tapón del Darién empieza en Yaviza, donde termina la Interamericana.
getting_in.quote: You can't cross from Panama to Colombia by bus—the Darien Gap begins at Yaviza, where the Interamericana runs out.

getting_around.en: Air travel is popular and widespread because there is no intercity rail and mountains separate many major cities.
getting_around.es: El avión es popular y está muy extendido porque no hay trenes interurbanos y las montañas separan muchas ciudades importantes.
getting_around.quote: Owing in part to the absence of intercity rail and the high mountains separating many of the major cities, air travel is popular and widespread among those who can afford it and competition is fierce.

getting_around.en: There are no intercity trains in the country.
getting_around.es: No hay trenes interurbanos en el país.
getting_around.quote: There are no intercity trains in the country.

getting_around.en: Long-distance bus trips rarely cost over US$55 one way, and you usually buy a ticket at the terminal for the next available bus.
getting_around.es: Los viajes de larga distancia en bus rara vez cuestan más de 55 US$ por trayecto, y normalmente se compra el boleto en la terminal para el siguiente bus disponible.
getting_around.quote: Long-distance trips rarely cost over US$55 (one way). When acquiring tickets for the bus, the local custom is that the passenger comes to the terminal and buys a ticket for the next available bus going to the desired destination.

getting_around.en: Foreign visitors may drive if they show an international driver's license.
getting_around.es: Los visitantes extranjeros pueden conducir si presentan un permiso de conducir internacional.
getting_around.quote: Foreign visitors may drive if they show an international driver's license (a multilingual endorsement card issued by automobile and driver's clubs around the world).

getting_around.en: Speed limits are 30 km/h in residential areas, 60 km/h in urban areas and 80 km/h nationally.
getting_around.es: Los límites de velocidad son 30 km/h en zonas residenciales, 60 km/h en zonas urbanas y 80 km/h a nivel nacional.
getting_around.quote: The speed limit in residential areas is 30 km/h (19 mph), and in urban areas it is 60 km/h (37 mph). There is a national speed limit of 80 km/h (50 mph).

getting_around.en: Cities have bus transit systems such as Transmilenio in Bogotá, Metroplus in Medellín, Mio in Cali and Transmetro in Barranquilla.
getting_around.es: Las ciudades tienen sistemas de buses como Transmilenio en Bogotá, Metroplús en Medellín, Mío en Cali y Transmetro en Barranquilla.
getting_around.quote: In Bogotá you can find the Transmilenio, in Medellín el Metroplus [1], in Cali el Mio, in Barranquilla Transmetro, in Bucaramanga Metrolínea, in Pereira the Megabús.

money.en: The currency of Colombia is the Colombian peso (COP), written with the $ symbol.
money.es: La moneda de Colombia es el peso colombiano (COP), que se escribe con el símbolo $.
money.quote: The currency of Colombia is the Colombian peso, but the symbol you will encounter is $ (ISO code: COP).

money.en: US dollars and euros can be exchanged at banks and authorised money exchanges, and money should not be changed on the street.
money.es: Se pueden cambiar dólares y euros en bancos y casas de cambio autorizadas, y no se debe cambiar dinero en la calle.
money.quote: You can exchange US dollars and euros at banks and authorised money exchanges. Do not change money on the street.

money.en: Credit and debit cards are widely accepted in hotels, shops and restaurants.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito y débito se aceptan ampliamente en hoteles, tiendas y restaurantes.
money.quote: Credit and debit cards are widely accepted in hotels, shops and restaurants.

money.en: ATMs are widely available, with varying withdrawal limits.
money.es: Los cajeros automáticos abundan, con límites de retiro variables.
money.quote: ATMs are widely available, with varying withdrawal limits (as of June 2024, unless otherwise noted):

money.en: A 10% service charge is generally added in nice restaurants, and tipping taxi drivers is not common.
money.es: En los restaurantes buenos suele añadirse un 10% de servicio, y no es habitual dar propina a los taxistas.
money.quote: A service charge of 10% is generally added to the bill in nice restaurants (if it's not, you should add it yourself). Tipping taxi drivers is not common.

money.en: When bargaining with street vendors, 10%-15% off is the generally accepted rule.
money.es: Al regatear con vendedores callejeros, lo aceptado en general es un descuento del 10% al 15%.
money.quote: Usually you can go down by COP$2,000-3,000, however 10%-15% is the generally accepted rule.

etiquette.en: Colombians are more formal than most other Latin Americans, so say please and thank you to everyone.
etiquette.es: Los colombianos son más formales que la mayoría de los latinoamericanos, así que diga por favor y gracias a todo el mundo.
etiquette.quote: Colombians are more formal than most other Latin Americans. Make a point to say "please" ("Por favor" or "Hágame el favor") and "thank you" ("muchas gracias") for anything, to anyone.

etiquette.en: Tactless remarks about the history of violence might earn a snide remark and an abrupt end to the conversation.
etiquette.es: Los comentarios imprudentes sobre la historia de violencia pueden provocar una réplica mordaz y el fin abrupto de la conversación.
etiquette.quote: tactless remarks about the history of violence might earn you a snide remark (likely regarding your country of origin) and an abrupt end to the conversation

etiquette.en: Colombians often point with their chins or lips, and pointing at a person or object with a finger can be considered rude or less discreet.
etiquette.es: Los colombianos suelen señalar con el mentón o los labios, y señalar con el dedo a una persona u objeto puede considerarse grosero o poco discreto.
etiquette.quote: Colombians have the mannerism of pointing to objects with their chins or lips; pointing to a person or even an object with your finger can be considered rude or less discreet.

etiquette.en: Indicating a person's height with the hand palm down is avoided because it is considered reserved for animals or inanimate objects.
etiquette.es: Se evita indicar la altura de una persona con la palma hacia abajo porque se considera reservado a animales u objetos.
etiquette.quote: Avoid indicating a person's height using your hand palm down, as this is considered reserved for animals or inanimate objects.

etiquette.en: Most Colombians are Catholic, and public displays of affection are rare and may draw uncomfortable stares.
etiquette.es: La mayoría de los colombianos son católicos, y las muestras públicas de afecto son raras y pueden provocar miradas incómodas.
etiquette.quote: Most Colombians are Catholic, although you'll find that young people are quite relaxed about religion, especially with regards to social issues. Public displays of affection are rare, though, and may elicit uncomfortable stares.

etiquette.en: Colombians dance a lot, and anyone will gladly teach you without expecting you to do it correctly.
etiquette.es: Los colombianos bailan mucho, y cualquiera le enseñará con gusto sin esperar que lo haga bien.
etiquette.quote: Colombians dance a lot. Anyone will be glad to teach you how to dance, and they will not expect you to do it correctly

connectivity.en: A SIM card and even an unlocked phone are easy to get at Bogotá's international airport, though at a higher price.
connectivity.es: Es fácil conseguir una SIM e incluso un teléfono libre en el aeropuerto internacional de Bogotá, aunque a mayor precio.
connectivity.quote: It's simple enough to get a SIM card and even an unlocked phone at the international airport in Bogotá, although there is, of course, a price hike.

connectivity.en: The main carriers are Claro, Tigo and Movistar, and Claro has the widest coverage.
connectivity.es: Los operadores principales son Claro, Tigo y Movistar, y Claro tiene la cobertura más amplia.
connectivity.quote: The carriers you'll most likely see are Claro, Tigo, and Movistar. Claro has the widest coverage in the country, if you expect to get off the beaten path.

connectivity.en: Topping up a SIM is easy and can be done on almost any street corner.
connectivity.es: Recargar la SIM es fácil y se puede hacer en casi cualquier esquina.
connectivity.quote: Topping up is also easy, and can be done pretty much on any street corner.

connectivity.en: Mobile and internet connection in rural areas is often limited.
connectivity.es: La conexión móvil y de internet en zonas rurales suele ser limitada.
connectivity.quote: Mobile and internet connection in rural areas is often limited.

connectivity.en: Internet cafés are easy to find in any city or town.
connectivity.es: Los cibercafés son fáciles de encontrar en cualquier ciudad o pueblo.
connectivity.quote: Internet cafés are easy to find in any city or town.
